metadata.title: SpatialMeet - A Virtual Office You Can Walk Around
metadata.description: SpatialMeet is a free virtual office in your browser. Walk around a pixel-art floor with your team and start a video call just by standing next to someone.
metadata.ogAlt: A SpatialMeet room: a 16-bit office floor with desks and teammates
metadata.keywords: virtual office, remote work, spatial chat, online collaboration, virtual workspace, metaverse office, proximity chat, proximity video chat, virtual coworking space, browser video calls
metadata.createRoomDescription: Open a virtual office room on SpatialMeet. Name it, add a password if you want one, then share one link with your team.
metadata.roomsDescription: Browse active virtual rooms and join public workspaces in SpatialMeet.
metadata.peopleDescription: Meet the people who hang out in SpatialMeet rooms.
metadata.authDescription: Sign in to SpatialMeet to keep your name, your character and a list of your rooms.

call.body: Get close to a teammate and their call bar appears above them. One tap opens video or voice, straight between browsers.

presence.body: Everyone carries a nameplate and a status. See who is free, who is heads down and who is already on a call before you walk up.

rooms.body: Rooms do not end when a meeting does. Keep one open for your team, put a password on it if you need to, and send the link once.

floor.title: An office, not a meeting.
floor.body: Nobody sends an invite. People drop in, work near each other, and wander over when something comes up.

items.a: SpatialMeet is a virtual office you walk around in. Your team appears as pixel-art characters on a shared 2D floor, and a video or voice call starts when you stand next to someone instead of when you click a meeting link.

items.q: Do I need to install anything?
items.a: No. SpatialMeet runs in the browser on desktop and mobile. Open a room link and you are inside the office.
Yes. Creating rooms, walking around, chatting and calling are free.

items.q: Do I need an account to join a room?
items.a: No. Anyone can join as a guest with just a name. Signing in only adds a saved profile, a character you keep, and a list of your rooms.

items.q: How do the video calls work?
items.a: Calls run peer-to-peer over WebRTC, so audio and video travel straight between browsers. Once a call is connected it stays connected until someone hangs up or leaves the room. Walking away will not drop it.

items.q: Is my camera on the whole time I am in a room?
items.a: No. The camera and microphone are opened only for a call and released the moment it ends.

items.q: Can I use SpatialMeet on a phone?
items.a: Yes. On touch devices you move with an on-screen joystick, and the call controls adapt to the smaller screen.

items.q: How is this different from a normal video call?
items.a: A normal call puts everyone in one grid until the meeting ends. A SpatialMeet room stays open all day, so you can see who is around, drift between conversations, and talk to the people you walk over to.
